//: SEC-001: an Invariant for every repository.
text: Never put a credential in a file, commit, log, PR, issue or reply, or hunt for one you were not given; if you find one, say where, not what.
why: Agents leak secrets into commits, and hunt for other credentials after an auth error.
enforced_by: gitleaks in the required secrets check, where the standards' gates run
to_add: gitleaks before each commit, because CI sees a secret only after it is pushed
sandbox read-deny on .env, ~/.ssh and cloud credentials
no production credentials in agent sessions
a guard hook that scans tool input for tokens
